ai_positioning.summary: ASMLF est le ticker OTC de ASML Holding NV (actions ordinaires Amsterdam). Memes fondamentaux que ASML : leader mondial monopolistique de la lithographie EUV, technologie indispensable à la fabrication des puces avancees (3nm, 2nm) pour l'IA. High-NA EUV represente le prochain palier pour les noeuds AI sub-2nm.
evidence: FY2024 net sales €28.3B, AI-driven demand pushing 2025 guidance €30-35B
High-NA EUV (EXE:5000) shipped to Intel, TSMC, Samsung for sub-2nm AI nodes
Backlog €36B end FY2024 driven by AI / HPC capacity expansion
R&D €4.3B FY2024 to maintain EUV / High-NA leadership
